document.abstract: Anscochrome Professional Film, Type 242, is a soft gradation reversible camera film for professional use. Duplicate prints from this new film on Type 238 Duplicating Stock can be made which approach original quality. The film is balanced for 3200 K and has an Exposure Index of 10. It is processed in the laboratories of the manufacturer.
